# The credential corpus. TestCorpus runs every line through the detector.
#
#   verdict | expectation | body
#
# verdict      strong  Strong must refuse the body, naming the kind in `expectation`
#              weak    only a warning, of the kind in `expectation` (never a refusal)
#              pass    never refused (a warning is allowed)
#              clean   no finding at all
# body         \n is a newline; {{NAME}} is a credential built from fragments by the test
#              (corpus_test.go), so this file holds nothing a secret scanner would flag.
#              TestCorpusFileHoldsNoCredential proves it.
#
# Every strong rule needs a line here (TestEveryStrongRuleHasACorpusLine).

# --- must be refused: one line per shape -------------------------------------------------------

# --- what this repo itself generates ---------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy/ops.sh gen_token: 48 letters and digits, for the shared, observer and per-machine
# tokens. Any 48-character word is too common to refuse, so a send only warns about it; the
# node and the CLI refuse the exact tokens they hold (canary_test.go).
weak | long random token | the new token is {{GEN48}} ok
weak | long random token | {{GEN48}}
weak | long random token | observer token {{GEN48}}
weak | password or token value | AIVOICEBUS_TOKEN={{GEN48}}
# a release signing key is its 32-byte seed in base64 (release.SavePrivateKey)
weak | long random token | signing key {{SIGNKEY}}
